scope.implementation: Owner-confirmed installation and device expression role adoption

independent_execution.environment: Production stores and HTTP with ControlLink memory device

fixed_findings.finding: Recovery could decide from a cached pre-recovery role snapshot.
fixed_findings.resolution: Requires a recovery read_roles command, a processed command result, a newer role sequence and no pending owner request before deciding.

fixed_findings.finding: A previously sent installation could be abandoned when a later installation was current at restart.
fixed_findings.resolution: Unfinished sent records are reconciled before the latest target; busy includes all unfinished installations.

fixed_findings.finding: A definite HTTP 409 could retain a stale binding in the browser pending request.
fixed_findings.resolution: Clear pending only when a definite conflict created no matching installation; keep the original ID after uncertain transport.

fixed_findings.finding: A saved current installation could keep its ready label after a profile or binding update.
fixed_findings.resolution: Mark current confirmation outdated while retaining the historical saved fact and frozen profile.

fixed_findings.finding: A confirmation arriving before the first reopened tick could supersede a sent record.
fixed_findings.resolution: Only unsent records can be superseded; sent work remains available for reconciliation.

fixed_findings.finding: A profile edit after a lost owner response could terminate an uncertain sent request before its device result.
fixed_findings.resolution: A persisted command continues result reconciliation; configuration updates prohibit new activation and retain the final device fact.

reviewed_boundaries: Revision conflicts and installation ID deduplication
Global lock order and manual/automatic exclusion
Latest unsent intent and old sent receipt ownership
Fresh recovery query and explicit retry
First-frame and saved facts recorded separately
Browser conflict recovery and lost POST response
Shell editor draft and focus retention
Concise design, mainline and joint handoff scope
acceptance_boundary: Offline implementation and automated integration reviewed. Physical USB installation observation and client persona/voice adoption remain the next joint acceptance steps.
